verdict.rationale: Speechmatics is an API-first product. It documents a public realtime WebSocket API reference (wss://global.rt.speechmatics.com/v2/ with temporary keys and config options), Batch and Text to Speech APIs, and language SDKs. It also documents programmatic workspace administration via tokens that create projects and manage API keys, plus job deletion. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
